neighbours.label: a capital K or J split off as its own token right after punctuation with no space (FBI-KGB, "Jaws", .King)
fire: The book describes the long FBI-KGB rivalry during the Cold War.
Classic films such as "Jaws," "Rocky" and "Alien" were screened.
In the test the code calls self.jack = Employee(name='Jack').
The poster listed films like "Jurassic Park" and "Ghost" for the week.
Cold War files on the CIA-KGB exchanges were declassified in 1995.
The playlist opened with "Kashmir" and ended with "Hey Jude".
She typed the name as user.kate in the config file by mistake.
The radio aired the CBS-KCBS broadcast late at night.
